scope: Everything certifiable against a real deployment without a signed-in session, run against the durable branch origin rather than a commit-specific URL.

checks.name: no secret-shaped key is served to a browser
no service_role JWT is served, decided by decoding the role claim
no service-role variable name appears in any asset
the publishable key and project URL ARE present, as they must be
the health route leaks no key material of any shape
the deployed build is Candidate 4 on the frozen calibration
the configuration flags are booleans
the provider still accepts the server's own credential
the deep probe returns no key material
the deployed credential is identified by fingerprint, never by value
a cloud save with no bearer token is refused
a guest claim with no bearer token is refused
a cloud save with a forged bearer token is refused
My EraClash requires an account and invents no career
the lobby offers an account and claims no signed-in identity
the device session cookie exists and is HttpOnly
the device session cookie is not readable from JavaScript
Dream Matchup is reachable at its own route for a guest
the gate states that a free account is required
the gate shows no price and no checkout
the gate offers both routes to an account and a way back
the gate's OWN call to action opens the account dialog
authenticating never navigates away from the mode being entered
dismissing the dialog leaves you on that route, not the lobby

note: No credential appears in this artifact: the bundle audit records counts and shapes only.
